A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with matching central theorems, counterexample, and main experiments. Text, equations, figures, and appendices are readable, including v1's checklist, and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MNIST training experiments and projected-gradient simulations on the eight-point circle dataset, including depth and width comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains the original MNIST and circle-dataset experiments and adds CIFAR-10 training experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The bias-free ReLU model, localized homogeneous loss, gradient-flow framework, and projected-gradient procedure are retained. Mathematical corrections and evaluation on CIFAR-10 do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: v2 adds CIFAR-10 experiments in Appendix C and Figures 5–6, extending the empirical coverage from handwritten digits and synthetic circle data to natural-image classification. Both existing datasets remain.

E2.justification: No comparison algorithm is added or removed. The rank-one reference and network width/depth comparisons remain; CIFAR-10 extends the existing network-depth analysis to another dataset.

E3.justification: The added CIFAR-10 experiments introduce specific schedules: 5,000 epochs with learning rate 40/||θ||^4 for six layers, and 10,000 epochs with 0.01/||θ||^4 for four layers. Existing MNIST settings and toy-experiment procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 extends the depth analysis to CIFAR-10, examining four- and six-layer singular-value evolution and spectra after the first escape and at training completion. This adds evidence about depth-dependent rank concentration while retaining the MNIST depth comparison and toy width sweep.

E5.justification: The results retain the same uncertainty-reporting practice: no confidence intervals or significance tests, and no new run-count or seed disclosures. The multiple-run toy plots remain. Removing v1's checklist also removes its explanation for omitting error bars, but the statistical reporting in the results is unchanged.

E6.justification: v2 Figures 5–6 add extensive CIFAR-10 loss trajectories and singular-value results for two depths, showing dominant singular values after escape and additional modes later. These are new outcomes under the added settings. The retained MNIST and toy findings remain unchanged; Figure 3's logarithmic rescaling is a display change.

T1.justification: v2 restores missing depth factors in Section 2.1's integrated dynamics, redefines escape time using output norm and replaces its approximation with a bound, and adds the condition ℓ > c² to Theorem 3.1. Appendix A adds elementary derivations and an AM–GM lemma. The principal low-rank result, counterexample, and proof strategy remain.

C1.justification: Section 1.3 corrects the counterexample contribution from two initial rank-two weight matrices to only the first matrix being rank two, matching Example 1 in both versions. The central approximate-rank-one claim and conjecture of increasing bottleneck rank are retained.

C2.justification: Section 2.1 adds an interpretation of directional dynamics as faster than norm growth near the origin. Section 2.2 newly connects escape-direction convergence with KKT convergence under cross-entropy and suggests extending gradient-flow analysis to gradient descent. The discussion's unresolved saddle-to-saddle conjectures remain.

D1.justification: New Appendix C documents CIFAR-10 layer dimensions, initialization, batch size, normalization, learning rates, and training budgets. MNIST implementation details remain unchanged. The removed checklist contained a generic GPU-resource statement, but neither version provides specific hardware or executable reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: v2 adds Kunin et al. (2024, 2025) and Zhang et al. (2025). It broadens the discussion of prior deep nonlinear analyses to include sign-stable ReLU settings and adds Frank–Wolfe/alternating-flow positioning. The overall research motivation and novelty remain substantially the same.

P1.justification: v2 makes local language and notation edits, improves cross-references, adds explanatory appendix subsections and a CIFAR-10 appendix, and removes the NeurIPS checklist. The main section order and argumentative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 substantially expands the empirical displays with two large CIFAR-10 multipanel figures and redraws MNIST Figure 3 using logarithmic singular-value axes. The conference template also resizes and repositions existing material. The original toy figures are retained as Figures 7–8.

improvement.justification: Corrected depth factors, the explicit layer condition in Theorem 3.1, and the corrected contribution summary improve precision; CIFAR-10 adds useful empirical corroboration. The gain remains limited: uncertainty estimates are still absent, Appendix A.8's statement omits the newly stated layer condition, and the full saddle-to-saddle dynamics remain conjectural.
